crossRefs.note: David went from there to Mizpeh of Moab, and he said to the king of Moab, “Please let my father and my mother come out…

translations.web: Therefore I hope to send him at once, as soon as I see how it will go with me.
translations.bsb: So I hope to send him as soon as I see what happens with me.
translations.kjv: Him therefore I hope to send presently, so soon as I shall see how it will go with me.
translations.asv: Him therefore I hope to send forthwith, so soon as I shall see how it will go with me:
